user_question: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Join tracts with county subdivisions
workflow_steps.purpose: Create a GeoPackage tract layer carrying the supplied county subdivision context while preserving tract geometry for downstream aggregation.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between the tract polygons and county subdivision polygons using their matching CRS. Preserve the tract polygon features and attributes, adding applicable county subdivision attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Aggregate hospital beds by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate total hospital beds located within each tract polygon.
workflow_steps.instructions: Sum the BEDS field from the hospital point layer within each tract polygon. Write the result to a numeric field named TOTAL_BEDS and retain the tract geometry and identifying attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Create total hospital beds choropleth
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce an interactive HTML choropleth map showing total hospital beds by Centre County tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive HTML choropleth from the tract layer, using TOTAL_BEDS as the mapped field. Include the supplied tract geometries and embed source and CRS verification metadata.

parameters.condition: Both input vector layers must use compatible coordinate reference systems for spatial joining.
Hospital points and tract polygons must use compatible coordinate reference systems for point-in-polygon aggregation.

parameters.field_purpose: Attribute to visualize in the choropleth.
